name: drafts-mcp
description: Bridge Claude to the Drafts app on macOS — create, search, append, and run actions on your drafts.
long_description: Connects Claude to the Drafts app on macOS. Create new drafts, read and search your existing drafts straight from the local database, append or prepend text, open drafts, and run Drafts actions — all by chatting. Requires the Drafts app installed on macOS; write operations need Drafts running so it can receive URL scheme calls.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Create a new draft with content, tags, and an optional action.

tools.name: get_draft
tools.description: Retrieve a draft's content by UUID (reads the local database).

tools.name: get_all_drafts
tools.description: List all drafts with metadata, filtered by folder or flag.

tools.name: search_drafts_db
tools.description: Full-text search drafts in the local database.

tools.name: append_to_draft
tools.description: Append text to an existing draft.

tools.name: prepend_to_draft
tools.description: Prepend text to an existing draft.

tools.name: open_draft
tools.description: Open a draft in the Drafts app by UUID or title.

tools.name: run_action
tools.description: Run a named Drafts action on some text.

tools.name: search_drafts
tools.description: Open the Drafts search UI with optional query/tag/folder filters.
